description: This interface defines the contract for reading interest rate chart slabs within the Fineract platform, including methods to retrieve all slabs, a specific slab, and templates.

classes.name: InterestRateChartSlabReadPlatformService
classes.description: An interface defining methods to read interest rate chart slabs, including retrieval of all slabs, a specific slab, and template data.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Retrieves all interest rate chart slabs associated with a given chart ID.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single interest rate chart slab based on chart ID and slab ID.

methods.name: retrieveWithTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves an interest rate chart slab using a provided slab data object, possibly for templated data.

methods.name: retrieveTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a template for interest rate chart slabs.
